description.p: Mandelbulb3D (MB3D), the 3D fractal program, rewritten as mb3d-rs so that it runs on Linux, with the picture calculated on the graphics card as well as the processor. It is an independent port of the original Windows program by Jesse and its contributors, not made by them.

It opens MB3D's parameter files and the text parameters people share in forums, uses MB3D's formulas and maps, and makes the same pictures. The windows are MB3D's own: Formulas, Lighting, Post processing, Navigator, Animation, Batch, Big renders, Monte Carlo, Voxel export, Bulb Tracer 2 and MutaGen. MB3D's tutorials apply.

ul.li: MB3D's formulas, maps and 80 example parameter files included
Calculation on the graphics card (Vulkan) and all processor cores
Animations, tiled big renders, Monte Carlo path tracing
Voxel and mesh exports for 3D printing
16 bit pictures, transparent backgrounds, a noise filter
A command line renderer for scripts and batch jobs

description.p: The command line renderer is started with: flatpak run --command=mb3d io.github.thr32423.mb3d-rs --help

description.p: Big pictures, Linux packaging and the command line:

ul.li: Pictures above 12000 pixels wide no longer run out of memory; depth of field is many times faster
Settings and History in the standard folders when installed as a system program; own formulas, maps and themes in ~/.local/share/mb3d-rs
Debian package, Flatpak, a man page and shell completions for mb3d
The command line: progress only on a terminal, exit codes, output to a pipe
